accounting.note: The columns measure ACTIVITY HOURS; the loop ranks on CASE SPAN. `case_span_not_visible_to_any_column` is the part of the span change that no per-activity column can show — time the case spends with nothing running (fitted extraneous-delay timers, routing that sends cases down longer paths). When it is large, a candidate in `applied_candidates_that_changed_routing_or_waiting` or `applied_candidates_owning_no_activity` may be driving the KPI while reading as 'nothing attributable to it alone'. A fact, not an accusation: settling it is what a confirmation simulation is for.
